Governments and healthcare professionals are taking steps to manage cases.

👉Pediatricians in Uttar Pradesh are emphasizing the importance of early treatment, and parents are being urged to seek immediate care if children exhibit high fever, breathing difficulties, or persistent cough.

👉In West Bengal, hospitals are actively managing RSV cases and focusing on prevention, particularly for infants and those with weakened immunity.
